note: Each SmartBite food mapped by hand to one monthly series of INSEE IPC-PM-2015 (Prix moyens de vente de détail, metropolitan France), by IDBANK, fetched as SDMX from the BDM web service. product is the series title (TITLE_FR); its unit, '(1 kg)' or '(pièce)', must match per. match: exact, close (same food, mixed with its subtypes or a stand-in cut), broad (no price, kept to show why). Only exact and close get an estimated price. Fresh foods only: INSEE has no dairy, eggs, grains, legumes or canned food, and a fresh price never stands for a frozen food.
